items.title: A cohomology class on a smooth affine curve over a field dies after a finite extension and a finite etale Galois cover of order dividing a power of the coefficient order
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for an extension of fields K/k, a smooth affine curve X over k with a rational point, and a torsion coefficient sheaf on Spec(K) with order invertible in k, every class in degree q > 0 dies after a finite extension K'/K and a finite etale Galois cover Z -> X_{k'} of group order dividing a power of n that splits over the rational point (statement lines 17356-17373). The proof (proof lines 17375-17443) treats the degrees above one by the vanishing theorem and a limit argument, and the degree one case by reducing to constant coefficients, realizing the class by a torsor, taking a Galois connected component and descending it. H2: a multi-step reduction with five independent inputs, written out in full.
